decisions.reason: The ribbon ornament is sourced, but the sole Fitness bow anchor does not establish an appropriate connection to badges rather than exercise or pose vocabulary.
The adjective candidates only refer to rostrum and do not explain the intended anatomical direction; the reptile-scale noun is a different sense.
Aircraft obtaining lift from rotors is an explicit broader category for helicopters, useful in transport business vocabulary.
The basketball meaning is directly sourced; retain US slang and uncountable labels instead of presenting it as a neutral international term.
The recovered massage and dry-transfer senses do not verify the proposed cleaning or wiping meaning.
An uninterrupted rehearsal is clearly defined and fits the performance anchor without imposing the other candidate's costume exclusion.
The draft defensive-tackle meaning conflicts with the ball-carrier candidate and an imprecise fast-defensive-position definition; keep that sports sense unresolved.
The exact sources define a native-born Israeli, not the proposed prickly-pear fruit, and the TOEIC tuna anchor adds a further homonym mismatch.
Nutrition scope was approved previously, but the source overgeneralizes the monosaccharide formula and carbon count to polymers; the WordNet description is too vague to repair that factual problem.
Policies protecting children and vulnerable adults are explicitly defined; preserve UK/Ireland formal restrictions and do not generalize to all conservation.
No attributable exact entry verifies the concatenated spelling; a spaced phrase correction still needs a reviewed source mapping.
Perceptual prominence and likelihood of being noticed clearly explain the emphasis-related meaning without a circular salient pointer.
The serving or display tray is directly sourced, avoiding unrelated healer senses and unsupported material or elegance requirements.
The selected source explicitly supplies optimism, while the separate temperament and pleasure-seeking senses remain unpublished.
The product candidate is a circular agent/form-of entry and does not verify germ-reduction claims; the compiler tool is unrelated to cleaner.
The sauce and saute cook in a professional kitchen is directly explained and matches the chef anchor, not the cookware homonyms.
A leisurely walker is independently defined; do not assert that the person is shopping or that every browser is walking.
Preserve the existing archive: reptile taxonomy does not teach the only Fitness lizard exercise or pose anchor.
The exact adjective describes an amount below the full or correct quantity; retain the qualified often-deliberate wording without claiming all scarcity is intentional.
The design of theatrical sets directly supports scenery vocabulary without adding unsupported scope claims about every production department.
School attendance and institutional education clearly establish the intended human education sense rather than horse training.
A careful examiner is directly sourced, providing a useful distinction from a passive viewer without invented scientific restrictions.
The candidates depend on secede, secession or secessionism and do not independently explain withdrawal from a union for learners.
Being constructed from or relating to segments is explicit; this does not promote the misleading implication that segmental simply means incomplete.
Shaking of the Earth's surface, an earthquake or tremor, directly verifies the intended event vocabulary.
The source supplies the literal suicide meaning without procedural detail, romanticization or the unsupported dramatic register recommendation.
The sole synonym pointer to self-government does not explain the intended internal control or sovereignty distinction.
No exact attributable sense was recovered for the adverb, so the proposed self-sufficiency meaning remains unverified.
Having a distinct individual identity is fully explained and matches identity; personality and selfishness alternatives stay separate.
No exact source supports this hyphenated identity or its proposed astronomy-specific radius meaning.
No exact source entry was recovered, and a style-guide claim in an old model gloss is not evidence for identity or meaning.
No exact plural meaning was recovered; older adults, school cohorts and rank-related senses need disambiguated source mapping.
Relating to sensation or the senses is clearly explained and directly supports the academic sensory anchor.
The bloodstream invasion definition supports infection vocabulary without asserting equivalence to every infection or offering diagnostic or treatment advice.
Holding shares in a corporation is explicitly explained and directly fits stockholder, without unsupported register claims.
The grooved pulley wheel is directly described and relevant to exercise equipment; it is not confused with the entire pulley or the verb for binding sheaves.
Temporary bracing against collapse is a concrete construction meaning for prop, not a Fitness exercise prop.
The ape-or-monkey noun is directly sourced and appropriate academic zoology; no figurative description of people is promoted.
Happening or existing at the same time clearly establishes temporal coincidence without the unrelated music-history claims.
The exact lexical entry directly identifies a guitar; no additional unsupported stylistic or technical specification is added.
